character: High-altitude circuit (2,200m) with thin air reducing aero and engine performance. Long back straight leads into a tight stadium section through the Foro Sol, surrounded by a packed grandstand.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/racing/2026/mexico/circuit official F1 circuit guide; Foro Sol stadium section naming well documented

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Brake early to compensate for reduced aero grip at altitude, late apex
corners.trap: Misjudging braking distance due to thinner air reducing downforce and drag

corners.name: Turn 4-6
corners.technique: Smooth, rhythmic direction changes, trust the grip despite the altitude
corners.trap: Over-driving the reduced-grip conditions at altitude

corners.name: Stadium Section
corners.type: tight, technical corners through the Foro Sol baseball stadium
corners.technique: Patient, precise low-speed inputs, use the atmosphere but stay focused on the tightening line
corners.trap: Getting distracted by the stadium crowd and missing braking points

corners.name: Final Corner
corners.type: long, tightening corner onto the pit straight
corners.technique: Progressive throttle as the corner opens, clean exit is critical
corners.trap: Early throttle application before the corner fully opens causes a slide
